# CoveredLife

> CoveredLife is an independent South African life insurance comparison service. We connect individuals and businesses with FSCA-authorised advisers (FSP 54871) who compare policies across South Africa's leading insurers, at no cost to the customer.

CoveredLife does not underwrite or sell policies directly. Advisers are compensated by insurers, not by customers, only when cover is successfully arranged.

## Personal Cover

- [Life Insurance](https://coveredlife.co.za/get-life-insurance): Tax-free lump-sum life cover quotes.
- [Compare Life Insurance](https://coveredlife.co.za/compare-life-insurance): Side-by-side comparison of South African life insurance policies.
- [Life Insurance Quotes](https://coveredlife.co.za/life-insurance-quotes): Start a free, no-obligation quote.
- [Life Insurance Cost](https://coveredlife.co.za/life-insurance-cost): What life insurance typically costs in South Africa.
- [Income Protection](https://coveredlife.co.za/get-income-protection): Monthly income replacement if you can't work due to illness or injury.
- [Individual Life Cover](https://coveredlife.co.za/individual-life-cover): Cover for a single applicant.
- [Family Life Cover](https://coveredlife.co.za/family-life-cover): Cover designed around family needs.
- [Over 50s Life Insurance](https://coveredlife.co.za/over-50s-life-insurance): Guaranteed-acceptance cover for people over 50.
- [Over 60s Life Insurance](https://coveredlife.co.za/over-60s-life-insurance): Cover options for people over 60.
- [Critical Illness Cover](https://coveredlife.co.za/get-critical-illness-cover): Lump-sum payout on diagnosis of a serious illness.

## Cover for Pre-Existing Conditions

- [Pre-Existing Conditions](https://coveredlife.co.za/pre-existing-conditions-life-insurance): Life cover options when you have a pre-existing condition.
- [Previously Declined](https://coveredlife.co.za/previously-declined-life-insurance): Options if you've been declined cover before.
- [Diabetes](https://coveredlife.co.za/diabetes-life-insurance)

- [High BMI / Obesity](https://coveredlife.co.za/high-bmi-obesity-life-insurance)
- [Other Chronic Conditions](https://coveredlife.co.za/other-chronic-conditions-life-insurance)

## Business Cover

- [Key Person Insurance](https://coveredlife.co.za/get-key-person-insurance): Protects a business against the financial impact of losing a vital team member.
- [Shareholder Protection](https://coveredlife.co.za/shareholder-protection-insurance): Cover to protect shareholders and business continuity.
- [Business Life Insurance](https://coveredlife.co.za/business-life-insurance): Life cover for company directors and businesses.
- [Executive Income Protection](https://coveredlife.co.za/get-executive-income-protection): Income protection for company directors, covering salary, bonuses and dividends.
